noFileInScope: No file left in scope "{scope}" after exclusions.
filesLine: {files} files, {excluded} excluded by the profile, {batches} batches:
guardArmed: Guard armed: excluded files are unreadable, writes are limited to the run and the reports.
consolidated: {findings} unique findings, {rejected} rejected by the schema.
profileChanged: ⚠ The profile changed since the previous scan: part of the difference may come from it.
partialScope: Partial scope: no "resolved" list, no history entry.
consistent: Profiles and config are consistent with the repository.
unsupportedLanguage: ✗ language "{value}" is not supported ({list}): English is used
noBuiltinNoOverlay: {type}: no built-in profile and no overlay
excludedRead: {rel} is excluded by the "{type}" profile ({glob}). Do not read it: the exclusion list is part of the profile.
scanWrite: Scan in progress ({run}): writes are limited to {allowed}. {rel} is not one of them — a scan reports, it does not fix.
scanCommand: Scan in progress ({run}): command that would modify the repository denied ({pattern}). Reading, counting and running tests is fine; writing is not. Write findings with the Write tool into the run directory.
remWrite: Remediation of {finding}: {target} is out of bounds ({glob}). Stop and report it instead of changing it.
remCommand: Remediation of {finding}: command denied by the config ({source}).
remProtected: Remediation of {finding}: the current branch "{branch}" is protected. Create the fix branch first.
remPush: Remediation of {finding}: push to a protected branch.
forbiddenTrailer: The last commit carries a forbidden attribution ({list}). Remove it with git commit --amend before going on.
unsupportedReportFormat: ✗ report format "{value}" is not supported ({list}): html is used
